name: Lightning
description: Eighties lightning bolts in hot colors, each striking across a little black-and-white checkerboard patch set askew behind it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 56%; height: 56%; left: @r(4%, 40%); top: @r(4%, 40%); background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: @var(--chk); mask: @var(--chk); transform: rotate(@r(-25deg, 25deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--bolt); clip-path: @var(--bolt); transform: translate(@r(-8%, 8%), @r(-6%, 6%)) rotate(@r(-28deg, 28deg)) scale(@r(.85, 1.05)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --bolt: polygon(58% 2%, 24% 54%, 46% 54%, 34% 98%, 78% 40%, 55% 40%, 72% 2%); --chk: conic-gradient(#000 0 90deg, transparent 90deg 180deg, #000 180deg 270deg, transparent 270deg) 0 0 / 50% 50% no-repeat, conic-gradient(#000 0 90deg, transparent 90deg 180deg, #000 180deg 270deg, transparent 270deg) 100% 0 / 50% 50% no-repeat, conic-gradient(#000 0 90deg, transparent 90deg 180deg, #000 180deg 270deg, transparent 270deg) 0 100% / 50% 50% no-repeat, conic-gradient(#000 0 90deg, transparent 90deg 180deg, #000 180deg 270deg, transparent 270deg) 100% 100% / 50% 50% no-repeat; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
